expectations.text: Registers a NATS micro service named exactly 'agents'
expectations.evidence: micro.Config{ Name: agentName } — names the service after the agent id, not the literal 'agents' discovery anchor; a caller filtering on service 'agents' would not find it

expectations.text: Serves the prompt endpoint on NATS queue group 'agents'
expectations.evidence: Uses per-agent subjects agents.<id>.prompt; queue group is per-agent, not the literal 'agents' group
No ack chunk; uses an SSE-style stream with id/type/payload frames and a terminal done frame

expectations.text: Terminates the stream with a zero-byte / header-less message
expectations.evidence: Terminates with a JSON 'done'/'error' frame, not a zero-byte header-less message

expectations.text: Provides working Go using the nats.go micro package

expectations.evidence: Explains micro auto-subscribes to $SRV.PING/INFO/STATS for discovery
